metadata.description: The Grok Build edition of LibreMobileDev: the Grok-native libre-mobiledev-grok plugin plus every LibreMobileDev-Claude-Code plugin, pinned by commit.

plugins.name: libre-mobiledev-grok
plugins.description: Grok-native mobile skills: mobile-a11y for screen reader, target and contrast checks, app-store-checklist for the submit gate, offline-first for local source of truth and a named conflict policy.

plugins.name: accessibility-mobile
plugins.description: Mobile accessibility for iOS, Android, and Flutter: VoiceOver, TalkBack, Flutter Semantics, Dynamic Type, touch targets, and WCAG 2.1 audits.

plugins.name: app-store-optimization
plugins.description: App Store and Google Play optimization: keyword fields, listing copy, screenshot sequences, store A/B tests, and rating prompts.

plugins.name: camera-media
plugins.description: Camera and media capture on iOS (AVFoundation), Android (CameraX, Camera2), and Flutter, including photo and video capture, frame processing, and ARKit or ARCore setup.

plugins.name: cross-platform-patterns
plugins.description: Cross-platform mobile architecture: Flutter platform channels, Kotlin Multiplatform, React Native TurboModules, and the decision of what to share versus build natively.

plugins.name: deep-linking
plugins.description: Deep linking for iOS Universal Links, Android App Links, custom URL schemes, deferred deep links, and in-app routing, with the server association files each needs.

plugins.name: flutter-development
plugins.description: Flutter 3.x development: widget design, Riverpod and BLoC state management, pigeon platform channels, custom painting, isolates, and performance profiling.

plugins.name: gesture-interaction
plugins.description: Touch gestures and haptics on iOS, Android, and Flutter: standard and custom recognizers, gesture conflicts, velocity-driven fling physics, and haptic timing.

plugins.name: kotlin-android
plugins.description: Native Android with Kotlin: Jetpack Compose, ViewModel with StateFlow, coroutines and Flow, Room, Hilt, and WorkManager.

plugins.name: location-services
plugins.description: Location on iOS, Android, and Flutter: CoreLocation, FusedLocationProvider, geolocator, geofencing, geocoding, maps, and battery-aware accuracy choices.

plugins.name: mobile-analytics
plugins.description: Mobile analytics and crash reporting: event taxonomy, funnels, Firebase Analytics, Amplitude, Mixpanel, AppsFlyer attribution, Crashlytics, and Sentry.

plugins.name: mobile-architecture
plugins.description: Mobile app architecture: Clean Architecture layers, MVVM, MVI, repositories, iOS coordinators, Android Navigation, feature modules, and feature flags.

plugins.name: mobile-ci-cd
plugins.description: Mobile CI/CD: Fastlane lanes, GitHub Actions for iOS and Android, code signing with match and keystores, and TestFlight, Firebase App Distribution, and Google Play releases.

plugins.name: mobile-payments
plugins.description: In-app purchases and subscriptions: StoreKit 2, Google Play Billing, RevenueCat, server-side receipt validation, restore flows, and subscription state.

plugins.name: mobile-performance
plugins.description: Mobile performance: profiling with Instruments, Android Profiler, and Flutter DevTools, launch time, memory, frame drops, list rendering, and battery.

plugins.name: mobile-security
plugins.description: Mobile app security: Keychain and Keystore storage, certificate pinning, biometric authentication, network security config, R8 obfuscation, and a security anti-pattern review.

plugins.name: mobile-testing
plugins.description: Mobile testing: XCTest and XCUITest, Espresso and Compose tests, Flutter widget, golden, and integration tests, Detox, and Firebase Test Lab device runs.

plugins.name: offline-first
plugins.description: Offline-first mobile data: local databases (Core Data, SwiftData, Room, Drift), sync queues, background sync, conflict resolution, and network state.

plugins.name: push-notifications
plugins.description: Push notifications: APNs token auth, FCM HTTP v1, Android notification channels, rich and silent push, and handling in foreground, background, and terminated states.

plugins.name: react-native
plugins.description: React Native: the New Architecture (JSI, TurboModules, Fabric), Expo and EAS, React Navigation, Reanimated 3, Zustand, TanStack Query, and list performance.

plugins.name: swift-ios
plugins.description: Native iOS with Swift: Swift concurrency, SwiftUI layout and navigation, UIKit interop, Combine, SwiftData, Swift Package Manager, and macros.

plugins.name: libre-mobiledev-hooks
plugins.description: Optional hooks for mobile projects: ask before touching signing keys, env files, or credentials and before destructive commands, warn on empty writes, and note the detected platforms at session start.
